map.如何使用AA制账单分摊？: How do I use Bill Splitter?
map.AA制账单分摊适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Bill Splitter best for?
map.多人聚餐/活动费用分摊，支持等额AA、按比例分摊、小费计算、逐项分摊: Split costs for group meals or events, supporting equal splitting, proportional shares, tip calculation and per-item splitting
map.含小费总额 = 总金额 × (1 + 小费% ÷ 100)；每人应付 = 含小费: Total with tip = total amount × (1 + tip% ÷ 100); each person pays = total with tip × that person's shares ÷ total shares
map.支持等额 AA 与按份数分摊两种模式。小费按整单百分比计，先并入总额再按各自份数: Supports two modes: equal splitting and splitting by shares. The tip is a percentage of the whole bill, added to the total first and then split by each person's share; the per-item mode lets you assign participants separately to each item and then totals what each person pays.
map.输入总金额和人数，自动计算人均费用: Enter the total amount and the number of people to get each person's share automatically
map.可添加小费/服务费比例: You can add a tip / service-fee percentage
map.可手动调整每个人的分摊比例（如有人吃得少/喝酒多）: You can manually adjust each person's share (for example someone ate less or drank more)
map.点击\"均分比例\"恢复平均分摊: Click "Split evenly" to restore an equal split
map.添加多个消费项目（餐费、酒水、打车等）: Add several expense items (meal, drinks, taxi and so on)
map.适用于复杂场景：有人不喝酒、有人没吃某个菜等: Fits complex cases: someone does not drink, someone skipped a dish, and so on
map.自动计算每个人应付的精确金额: Automatically computes the exact amount each person pays
map.聚餐/合租平摊含小费。: Split group meals or shared rent with a tip included.
map.合租水电费按各房间人数分摊，设置每人份数后自动得到各自应付。: Split shared utilities by the number of people in each room; set each person's shares and each person's amount is computed automatically.
map.总 300 元、3 人、含 10% 小费 → 每人 (300×1.1)/3=11: Total 300 yuan, 3 people, with a 10% tip → each person (300×1.1)/3 = 110 yuan.
map.可设免单人，余额由其余均摊。: You can mark someone as exempt; the balance is shared evenly among the rest.
map.小费是按总额还是按人头加？: Is the tip added on the total or per person?
map.计入后再拆分，等效于每人按自身份数占比承担同比例小费。: of the whole bill, added to the total and then split, equivalent to each person bearing the same tip ratio in proportion to their shares.
map.AA制账单分摊。日常生活工具，贴近生活，实用便捷。: Bill Splitter. A daily-life tool that is practical and convenient.
